intent: newly generated photorealistic assets, not original PDF illustrations

prompts.dog:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one reusable photographic cutout for a children's counting lesson; labels will be added separately by the app.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with a real alpha channel, not a checkerboard pattern or a solid background.
Style/medium: photorealistic studio catalog photograph, natural material texture, soft neutral lighting, sharp detailed subject edges, not an illustration or 3D render.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete subject, centered in a square frame, at least 10% clear transparent padding on every side, subject entirely visible and unobstructed.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logo, watermark, emoji, icon, border, card, backdrop, floor, props, duplicates, ground shadow, or separate shadow patch. Do not crop any part. Preserve clean natural edges and true transparency.
Subject: One real golden retriever dog, full body standing in a natural slightly side-on pose with the four legs offset so all four complete paws are separately visible. Entire head, both ears, torso, all four legs, all paws, and whole tail visible. Real golden fur and natural canine face and proportions, no collar or accessories, no human expression.
